lesson.child_mission: Adding two- and three-digit numbers aligns places and regroups ten ones as one ten (and ten tens as one hundred) when needed.
lesson.evidence_instructions: Save the independent response, specific revisions and both short-answer explanations; record oral evidence for speaking tasks.
lesson.extension: Apply the same method to a larger number or a new context, then compare two solution paths for accuracy.
lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Add 365 + 278 with place columns. Show any regrouping.

FEEDBACK
Ones 13 → 3 carry 1; tens 6+7+1=14 → 4 carry 1; hundreds 3+2+1=6; sum 643.

WATCH FOR
Adding digits without aligning places (365+278 as 3+2, 6+7, 5+8 separately into a scramble) breaks place value.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Compute six additions (mix of 2-digit and 3-digit, at least four needing regrouping). Show columns and carries. Estimate one answer first and compare.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.
